changes: Auto-dial now shows the whole list while a run is going — the numbers still waiting appear as “Queued”, the one being called as “Calling…”, and finished ones with their result — so you can see the full run after leaving the page and coming back. The numbers box also keeps the running list.
Auto-dial has Pause and Resume: hold the run between calls and pick it back up where it left off, without losing your place.
The sidebar shows auto-dial progress at a glance: a blue count of how far along the run is, and a green count of how many lines answered.

The Calls page is more compact: a dense list you can scan quickly, with the type, who, time and length on one line. Click any call to open its recording, AI summary and transcript, and a Call-back button.

Auto-dial now keeps running when you leave the page: the dialing happens in the background, so you can switch to Messages or anything else and come back to watch it. The Auto-dial page shows the run live and lets you stop it.

New Auto-dial page: paste a list of numbers and call them one at a time to see what answers each one — a person, a fax or modem tone, a disconnected-number tone, or no answer. It records a few seconds of each answered call, times how long it rang, and you can export the whole run as a CSV. You can pick which of your phones to dial out on, so a long run doesn't tie up your main line. For numbers you own or are authorized to test; calls go out paced, one at a time.

Call waiting: when someone rings while you're already on a call, it shows as a second line with Answer and Decline. Answering puts your first caller on hold, and from there you can Swap, Merge, or Transfer.
Calls no longer drop when the phone briefly loses its connection: the connection is kept alive, and a call in progress stays up while it reconnects.
In-call keypad: you now hear the touch-tone for each key, the digits you've pressed show above the keypad, and you can type digits on your keyboard while the keypad is open.

Make a call works during a call: pick who to call and your current caller stays on hold. Then Swap between them, Merge them, or Transfer. The Call buttons in Messages and Contacts dial straight away the same way.
Reactions: hover over someone's text and pick 👍 ❤️ 😂 🙏 ✅ or 👀. The emoji is sent on its own, and emoji-only texts show large.
Suggested replies: when someone has texted you, three short replies appear above the message box. Click one to put it in the box, then press Enter to send.
Sending a text clears the message box right away. The message shows in the conversation as "Sending…" while it goes out, so you can type the next one straight away.
A text that doesn't go through stays in the conversation marked "Not sent", with Retry and Delete.
Fax: a failed fax now says why in plain words (for example, the number isn't a fax machine), and the list no longer squashes the name and date.
Triage now reads whole conversations, not single texts. The Triage page shows one card per conversation, updated as new texts arrive, and it leaves the queue when you reply.
In Messages, press Triage on any conversation to see what's going on, what's still open, and a suggested reply you can drop into the message box.
Missed calls now show up in the phone's recent calls right away, marked in red with "Missed".
Four plain themes with no animation: Graphite, Midnight, Forest and Plum. Pick one in Settings > General > Theme.
After an update, Switchboard shows what changed (this window).
Six new animated themes: Aurora, Marble, Mercury, Dawn, Vapor and Velvet. Pick one in Settings > General > Theme.
Connect Switchboard to Claude from Settings, and use Claude Code as the AI for triage.
